added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run own completed matched importer logs and importer-results.json; manifest after_suite instead describes the focused test and is not comparable to its importer baseline. No attribution of these failures to the change is established.

assertion_analysis.condition_for_failure: Committed review storage is unavailable; prevents a vacuous fixture.
The instrument no longer sees each known committed review file; guards the positive control before interpreting counts.
Instrumentation misses the canonical reader binding.
The producer omits or substitutes a synthetic run in its initial events.
Removing the tick memo or its watch context restores repeated reads; recorded base has six per run, not one.
The rewrite replaces the inode, invalidating the intended in-place control.
The rewrite changes directory identity, making a directory-only invalidator sufficient.
The producer does not reach the supplied sleeper after the next quiet tick.
A tick reuses prior identities without reads or repeats the reader per run; removing memo yields four or six instead of one.
Retaining identities across ticks or coarsening review identity to directory metadata leaves the rewritten run key unchanged, or unrelated keys change.

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares an echoed input to itself: counts observe real reader calls, identities observe filesystem metadata, events observe producer output, and changed keys compare independently observed pre/post snapshots.

Base failed 3, 5 and 5 of 5; head failed 4, 5 and 5 of 5. They are timing-sensitive producer tests failing at base on this node, not failures the change added.

1.reason: Corrected rather than declined: at landing the coordinator re-records baseline_suite and after_suite as one matched pair, running the run's armed command at base and at head, with the node test copied onto base, and lands on that pair.

blocking: after_suite names the two-test focused run whereas baseline_suite names 126 importer files, so directly subtracting these fields falsely reports zero added failures; publish a matched importer suite pair or an explicit matched-pair gate receipt before accepting the no-regression evidence.
